findings.title: LoggerSpy.Entry field named MessageTemplate actually stores the rendered string
findings.detail: In DevConsoleSmsSenderTests.cs the spy stores formatter(state, exception) — the fully rendered message ('Dev SMS ****3456 Your Taxi verification code: 123456') — into a field named MessageTemplate. It is not the template. This is not a correctness issue: asserting Contain(code)/NotContain(code) against the RENDERED string is precisely what makes the production-masks test a genuine regression pin (asserting against the literal template '...{Body}' would pass unconditionally and be a fake pin). The naming is merely misleading.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the Entry field to Rendered (or assert on the State KVP for the {Body} value). Non-blocking cosmetic.
